blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Police arrested a man for allegedly shooting and killing his wife in a dispute over financial support for their children in Antipolo City, Rizal, on Thursday morning. The suspect, a security guard employed by the provincial government, allegedly shot his wife in front of the Ynares Center at L. Memorial Circle in Barangay San Roque at around 11:45 a.m., the Antipolo City police said. The couple had just negotiated a financial support arrangement for their children at the provincial government’s Human Resources Office, police said.
